scripts.text:
--stg_process
if exists (
select request_source, patient_row_id 
from [ecms].[pms_patient]
group by request_source, patient_row_id
having count(*) >1 ) 

select 1 as duplicated else select  0 as duplicated;
GO

--stg_process
delete from [ecms].[pms_patient]
where request_source in (select request_source
from [ecms].[pms_patient]
group by request_source, patient_row_id
having count(*) >1);
GO
